title: Crownlands - Archers battel test
author: Crownlands_dev
selftext:
Hey everyone 👋👋

This is a test of the archery system I’m working on for my open-world RPG. The game will have quests, crafting, building, dungeons, and many other interesting things to explore.

At the moment, the shooting works like this: the player aims at a specific spot with the cursor, and when they shoot, the arrow flies directly toward that point.

But I’m also considering making the shooting a bit less precise. The arrow wouldn’t always hit exactly where the cursor is pointing, but instead would randomly land somewhere within a small area around the cursor. This area would become smaller as the player levels up their Archery skill, making their shots more accurate.

Im using Claud code for coding, Meshi AI for 3d modeling, I also use ChatGPT to help me create concept art for the game. I sometimes run into problems with animations and fitting clothes to different character body types, and quite often I have to adjust and fix everything manually.

Since I’m developing the game completely solo, I’d really appreciate hearing your thoughts on this idea! What do you think would feel better for this kind of RPG? 😊
